contents: Frozen request manifests, 1830 saved detection/diagnostic responses, 20 Text localization responses, format selection, source references and audit reports. Dataset image bytes are not duplicated.
validation: Use source checkout 247ea81 (before the full-campaign scheduler-only change). Extract archive to an empty directory, then run PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/audit_detection_search.py <directory> --complete with the same detection dataset. The frozen source hashes intentionally reject later source revisions.
